item.title: Minister: Iran is ready to Share cybersecurity expertise with Iraq
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Noting Iran's readiness to share its cybersecurity expertise with Iraq, the Minister of Information and Communications Technology said that Iran had been subjected to massive cyberattacks—particularly during the recent imposed war—and has gained valuable experience in this field.

item.title: Araghchi: US must return to its commitments and Islamabad MoU
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Referring to his meetings and discussions on the first day of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit—and noting that in all these meetings he emphasized the Iranian nation's resolve to secure its rights and also discussed the aggressive actions of the United States and their consequences—Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran Abbas Araghchi said that the United States must return to its commitments and the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding.

Tehran, IRNA – Referring to his meetings and discussions on the first day of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit—and noting that in all these meetings he emphasized the Iranian nation's resolve to secure its rights and also discussed the aggressive actions of the United States and their consequences—Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran Abbas Araghchi said that the United States must return to its commitments and the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding.

item.title: Pakistan PM invites Pezeshkian to visit Islamabad
item.description: Islamabad, IRNA - Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has formally invited Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian to pay an official visit to Islamabad at the earliest possible opportunity, while President Pezeshkian extended a reciprocal invitation for Sharif to attend the upcoming ECO summit in Tehran.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86251363/Pakistan-PM-invites-Pezeshkian-to-visit-Islamabad

Islamabad, IRNA - Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has formally invited Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian to pay an official visit to Islamabad at the earliest possible opportunity, while President Pezeshkian extended a reciprocal invitation for Sharif to attend the upcoming ECO summit in Tehran.
